project.title: Community Outreach Program Launch and Operations Setup
project.objective: Design and launch a pilot community outreach program with clear processes, staffing, and measurement to support vulnerable residents and build long-term engagement.
deliverables: Community outreach program charter and scope
Standard operating procedures for outreach activities
Community events calendar and engagement plan
Monitoring and evaluation framework with KPIs
Risk and incident handling guidelines for field activities
constraints: Limited budget requiring use of existing staff and volunteers
Compliance with data protection and safeguarding regulations
All materials must be accessible and inclusive
Activities must align with existing organisational policies
Measurement framework must use only available data sources

risks.risk: Low community participation in initial outreach events.
risks.mitigation: Use targeted promotion, partner with local organisations, and adjust messaging based on early feedback.

risks.risk: Insufficient staff or volunteers to run planned activities.
risks.mitigation: Phase activities, prioritise critical events, and coordinate with HR for rapid internal recruitment.

risks.risk: Non-compliance with privacy or safeguarding requirements.
risks.mitigation: Create clear guidelines, train all staff and volunteers, and implement simple incident reporting procedures.

risks.risk: Lack of reliable data to evaluate program impact.
risks.mitigation: Define a minimal data set, standardise collection templates, and assign clear data responsibilities.

risks.risk: Scope creep due to additional community requests.
risks.mitigation: Document scope in charter, set intake rules for new ideas, and review changes with executive leadership.

themes.why_relevant: Clarifies what the outreach program will and will not do, and who approves changes.
Ensures the right people are recruited, briefed, and supported for community-facing work.
Defines how events are planned, promoted, and delivered to maximise participation.
Allows the team to track outcomes, report to leadership, and refine the program.
Shapes messaging, outreach channels, and media handling to build trust and visibility.
Standardises procedures and reduces operational and safeguarding risks in the field.

backlog.task: Draft and approve the community outreach program charter
definition_of_done: Charter document includes objectives, scope, target groups, and success criteria
Roles and decision rights are clearly defined
Risks and assumptions are documented
Charter is reviewed and approved by executive leadership

backlog.task: Define staffing needs and recruitment plan for the pilot
definition_of_done: List of required roles, skills, and time commitments is documented
Draft role descriptions for staff and volunteers are prepared
Recruitment channels and timelines are agreed
Plan is validated with chief executive officer and management assistant

backlog.task: Design the initial three community outreach events
definition_of_done: Event concepts, objectives, and target audiences are defined
Proposed dates, locations, and formats are listed
Basic logistics and resource needs are estimated
Plan is aligned with program charter and approved by chief executive officer

backlog.task: Create a central information hub for outreach materials
definition_of_done: Folder structure and naming conventions are defined
Key documents and templates are uploaded and tagged
Access rights are set for all team members
Short usage guide is shared in the Slack channel

backlog.task: Develop the monitoring and evaluation framework
definition_of_done: Key indicators and data sources are defined
Simple data collection templates are created
Baseline and target values are proposed where possible
Framework is reviewed with chief executive officer and accepted

backlog.task: Set up operational processes and checklists for field activities
definition_of_done: Standard operating procedures for events and visits are drafted
Checklists for pre-event, during-event, and post-event tasks are created
Process is validated with event manager and human resources assistant
Final version is shared with the team

backlog.task: Prepare communication and promotion plan for the pilot
definition_of_done: Key messages and tone of voice are documented
List of communication channels and timelines is created
Draft content outline for flyers and online posts is prepared
Plan is aligned with organisational guidelines and approved by chief executive officer

backlog.task: Define volunteer onboarding and basic training content
definition_of_done: Onboarding steps and responsibilities are listed
Training topics include safeguarding, privacy, and communication basics
Simple slide deck or handout outline is created
Training approach is reviewed with event manager and management assistant

backlog.task: Plan detailed logistics for the first outreach event
definition_of_done: Venue, date, and time are confirmed
Equipment, materials, and staffing are assigned
Risk and contingency plan for the event is documented
Event checklist is completed and shared with the team

backlog.task: Implement data collection process for pilot events
definition_of_done: Data collection tools are tested in a dry run
Team members know how and when to capture data
Data storage location and access rules are defined
Post-event data review process is documented

backlog.task: Coordinate overall project timeline and dependencies
definition_of_done: High-level timeline with milestones is created
Dependencies between tasks T1-T10 are mapped
Risks to the launch date are highlighted
Timeline is agreed in the team and shared in Slack

backlog.task: Prepare a pilot launch briefing for internal stakeholders
definition_of_done: Briefing outlines purpose, scope, and expected benefits
Key dates and asks for internal teams are listed
Slides or summary document is created using latest plans
Briefing is delivered or scheduled with stakeholders

artifacts.title: Staffing and Volunteer Recruitment Plan
artifacts.used_for: Tracks required roles, candidates, recruitment status, and onboarding dates.

artifacts.title: Outreach Events Operating Procedures
artifacts.used_for: Provides step-by-step instructions and checklists for planning and running events.

artifacts.title: Monitoring and Evaluation Framework
artifacts.used_for: Lists indicators, data sources, collection frequency, and owners for the pilot.

artifacts.title: Volunteer Onboarding and Training Pack
artifacts.used_for: Explains onboarding steps, training topics, and key policies for volunteers.

artifacts.title: Community Events Calendar and Engagement Plan
artifacts.used_for: Summarises planned events, target audiences, and promotion activities.

artifacts.title: Single Event Logistics and Risk Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Ensures all logistical, safety, and data collection steps are completed per event.

artifacts.title: Central Outreach Knowledge Hub Index
artifacts.used_for: Index of folders and documents so the team can quickly find latest materials.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on program charter, scope, and success criteria for the pilot.
threads_plan.trigger: Initial kick-off message from chief executive officer sharing draft charter A1.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve or adjust the proposed program scope and target community segments in A1.
Confirm the top three success metrics to track in the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define staffing, volunteer needs, and onboarding approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Human resources assistant posts first draft of staffing and recruitment plan A2.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the number and type of volunteers needed for the first three events.
Approve the volunteer onboarding flow and training topics in A5.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock in the design and logistics for the first outreach event.
threads_plan.trigger: Event manager shares proposed concept and logistics checklist A7 for event 1.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select final date, time, and location for the first outreach event.
Approve the event run-of-show and minimum staffing requirements.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on monitoring, evaluation, and data collection processes.
threads_plan.trigger: Statistician posts draft monitoring and evaluation framework A4.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the final list of indicators and data collection frequency.
Decide who is responsible for data capture during each event.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Set up operational processes, knowledge hub, and overall timeline.
threads_plan.trigger: Management assistant shares draft SOPs A3 and knowledge hub index A8.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final structure and access rules for the outreach knowledge hub.
Confirm the project timeline and key milestones before launch.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in each morning with top priority and blockers for the day.
Weekly planning message every Monday to confirm events and key tasks for the week.
Post-event debrief thread within 24 hours of each outreach event to capture learnings.
Mid-pilot review discussion to adjust scope, staffing, and metrics based on early results.
